identification: Mixed box of 1970s-80s comics and magazines: Gold Key comics, a Marvel 50c comic (Oct, #7), DC comics, Simpsons Comics (Bongo, 1990s), Star Trek III Search for Spock Marvel movie comic special and Star Trek magazines, 'Orphan from Krypton' (Superman paperback comic), Garfield books in a slipcase, Walt Disney's Donald Duck Fun Library paperbacks (about 8), plus two bags of Glad trading cards (aircraft and cars) and a Garfield 'whatever' disc. Estimate 40-70, bid $15.

viewing_check: Read the numbers on the Gold Key tags: 90210-401 to -711 are common (A$12-25), but any Gold Key with a 10210- code or a 12c/15c cover is a 1967-72 issue worth A$20-400 (Gold Key Star Trek #1 asks US$415 VG). Look for a Simpsons Comics #1 and check the Frew Phantom number (a low-number Frew, under about #300, can ask A$100-200). Count the fact cards in the two bags and read the red 'No.5' comic and the yellow-armour item.
